offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures radiation detection, measurement and monitoring instruments, along with dosimetry services and software. Sells to nuclear power plants, hospitals and cancer centers, defense and homeland security agencies, and industrial users, mainly through direct sales. Makes products in its own plants and delivers recurring dosimetry, calibration and monitoring services.

primary_products.value: radiation detection instruments; personal dosimeters; medical radiotherapy and imaging quality assurance systems; nuclear instrumentation; radiation monitoring software

primary_services.value: dosimetry services; instrument calibration; managed radiation monitoring; consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: nuclear power plants, hospitals and cancer centers, industrial radiography firms, defense contractors; B2G: defense and homeland security agencies, national laboratories, nuclear regulators

end_markets.value: nuclear power; healthcare; defense and homeland security; industrial; research

revenue_model.value: product sales: radiation detection instruments, sensors and dosimeters sold to utilities, hospitals and governments; service fees: dosimetry, calibration and monitoring services; subscription: recurring dosimetry service and software contracts

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds radiation detectors and instruments from components, sold to nuclear, medical and government customers; service provider: takes in customer dosimeters and instruments for calibration and monitoring, sold to plant and hospital operators; software / platform: radiation monitoring and data software sold with instruments to nuclear and medical users
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; service provider; software / platform

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: radiation detection instruments, dosimetry services, medical imaging quality assurance and nuclear monitoring systems

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct sales teams serving nuclear utilities, hospitals and government accounts; distributors / dealers: regional distributors serving smaller customers and some international markets

regulatory_exposure.value: high: medical radiation devices needing FDA clearance, nuclear instruments subject to NRC licensing and IAEA standards

notes: Based on general knowledge of the company; the exact segment and customer mix may have changed.
